name: B10-0396/2026 (The Left) – Political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the United States blockade of Cuba, in place since 1962, to be lifted immediately. It says the blockade breaks international law, hurts ordinary Cubans through shortages of fuel, electricity, food and medicine, and harms European companies. It asks the European Union to send more humanitarian aid, to protect European businesses from US penalties, and to raise the cases of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro with Cuba through existing EU-Cuba talks. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks for the US blockade to end and for more EU aid to Cuba.
- It affects Cubans facing shortages and European companies hit by US penalties.
- Next, the text goes to EU institutions and Cuba's government; nothing changes automatically.
